# 1 Enoch Chapter 38 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 38:2 — "Righteous One" vs. "righteous man" (the eschatological judge figure)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-Righteous-One" | Capitalized title; distinct eschatological figure |
| LOGOS | "the Righteous One" | Same; capitalized as a title |
| PNEUMA | "the Righteous One" | Agrees with LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** No substantive disagreement. All capitalize, identifying a specific figure (the pre-existent judge of chs. 46–48). Consensus holds.

**Status:** Consensus.

---

## 38:3 — "look upon the face" vs. "behold the faces"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "behold-the-face of-the-holy-ones" | Singular "face" following Ge'ez construct |
| LOGOS | "look upon the faces of the holy" | Plural, more natural in English |
| PNEUMA | "look into the faces of the holy" | "Into" implies intimacy/shame |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "look upon the face of the holy ones" — singular "face" preserves the Ge'ez idiom. "Into" (PNEUMA) imports an idea not present.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 38:6 — "Elect One" vs. "Chosen One"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Elect-One" | Technical term; Ge'ez xəbuʾ = chosen/elect |
| LOGOS | "Elect One" | Standard scholarly rendering |
| PNEUMA | "Chosen One" | More natural English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Elect One" adopted throughout (LOGOS standard). "Chosen One" loses the technical resonance that distinguishes this figure as the pre-existent Elect One of chs. 45–49.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. This ruling applies throughout chs. 38–71.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
